The Nikai group of companies today stands tall on a foundation
of trust, built right from our inception in 1995. Every step of
the way, we gave our customer true value in terms of product
and service. What started out as a trading enterprise (Crescent
General Trading) has grown into a global conglomerate with
business interests in information Technology, Outsourcing,
Electronics and Appliances, to name a few.
Nikai Total Home Solutions: With an impressive offering of over
400 products, available in 80 countries around the world, Nikai
has created a unique niche in an altogether new category of ‘Total
Home Solutions’. From the smallest appliance to high-end LEDs,
Nikai takes great pride in offering the entire range at a price that
is reasonable. Manufactured under strict quality controls, coupled
with exceptional product design and service, the brand towers
over competition on the strength of these pillars.
Vision: To build a diversified global business house providing
reliable products and exceptional service offering superior value
